INSERT INTO contacts (id, companyId, firstName, lastName, email, phone, jobTitle, linkedinUrl, createdAt, updatedAt)
SELECT 
  UUID() as id,
  c.id as companyId,
  'Thomas' as firstName,
  'Hasler' as lastName,
  'thomas.hasler@sika.com' as email,
  '+41 58 436 68 00' as phone,
  'CEO' as jobTitle,
  'https://www.linkedin.com/in/thomas-hasler-sika' as linkedinUrl,
  NOW() as createdAt,
  NOW() as updatedAt
FROM companies c WHERE c.name LIKE '%Sika%' LIMIT 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  UUID(), c.id, 'Adrian', 'Widmer', 'adrian.widmer@sika.com', '+41 58 436 68 01', 'CFO', 'https://www.linkedin.com/in/adrian-widmer-sika', NOW(), NOW()
FROM companies c WHERE c.name LIKE '%Sika%' LIMIT 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  UUID(), c.id, 'Maria', 'Schmidt', 'maria.schmidt@sika.com', '+41 58 436 68 02', 'Head of Sales', 'https://www.linkedin.com/in/maria-schmidt-sika', NOW(), NOW()
FROM companies c WHERE c.name LIKE '%Sika%' LIMIT 1;
